Thank you for registering for our **Grand Opening on October 21, 2026.** We’re delighted to confirm your participation.


You can look forward to an inspiring afternoon to learn more about our new facility for 3D printing for Aerospace & Defense and Semiconductor equipment production, as well as opportunities to network with 3D Systems executives, industry leaders, customers, partners, and local government officials.
